content: He gallas laapun maccasati issi adde oykidi, “Nuuni nu kathi maana; nu ma7o ma7ana. Ne sunthan xeegetana mela oothada nu kawusha nuupe diggarkii?” yaagidi woossana.
He wode Godaa tashey, lo77ananne bonchetana; attida Isra7eele asaas biitta kathay ceeqonne boncho gidana.
Xiyoonen attidaysati, Yerusalaamen dhayope kessi ekidaysatinne de7os xaafetidaysati geeshshata geetetana.
Goday Xiyoone maccasa qita meeccana; ba pirdaaninne ba ayyaana taman suutha guso Yerusalaamepe diggana.
Goday Xiyoone zumaa bollanne yan shiiqiya ubbaa bolla gallas shaara cuyanne qamma tama laco medhana; iya boncho ubbaa bolla kama gidana.
I, gallasa mishape ashshiya kuyanne uushopenne irape qosetiya besse gidana.
